description: Show one Drint mockup in an interactive 3D viewer the user can rotate, zoom, recolour and resize. Take the id from search_mockups. Optional: colour (a colour or material name, or its number from 0), and a custom size in millimetres (length, width, height).

colour.description: A colour / material name the model offers, or its number (0 = first).

id.description: The model id from search_mockups, e.g. "gift-ceramic-30".

lang.description: The user's language (vi, en, th, zh…). Default en.

name: open_mockup
title: Open a 3D mockup
